justification: Both surfaces present a humanoid figure with some circular/disc motif on the torso, but that is a very generic correspondence; A shows a densely detailed narrative scene of a striding winged bird-headed creature confronted by a bearded winged figure with weapon and elaborate feather, scale and fringe patterning, while B shows a single frontal blocky standing figure with sparse, schematic incised marks and no wings, animals, weapons or narrative interaction. The manners of depiction differ sharply: fine profile relief with rich internal texture versus massive plain volumetric form with minimal shallow incision.
